newsitem.title: UK: Next leg-up in nickel to target $10,000-Waterside.
newsitem.headline: Next leg-up in nickel to target $10,000-Waterside.

text.p: Following nickel's present correction, three month prices should resume their upward path with the next target around $10,000, Waterside Futures said.
"The extent of the recent decline suggests that the selling is set to continue," the broker's Wave Track report, which uses Elliott Wave analysis, said.
If the market fails to hold at $7,580-$7,620, where the market found good support in February, the next floor is pegged at $7,345.
In LME trading on Tuesday, nickel slumped to a low of $7,675.
"However, once the correction is out of the way, then the bull market should resume with an extremely aggressive rally towards the $10,000 level," Wave Track said.
Eventually, prices should reach $13,000 over the next 12 months, moving in three basic waves, the report said.
In copper, the recent failure to break above $2,390 allows for a decline towards a minimum target of $2,330, or possibly $2,251/61, Wave Track said.
The larger trend remains bullish, however, with the ultimate target over the year at $2,852, it said.
